Blog

How to spot real khaddar

Look at the weave. Real khaddar has a slight natural unevenness and feels soft and dry in the hand. Rub it between your fingers: it should feel breathable, never slippery or plastic. Ask the seller for the fabric name and meters per suit; a trusted seller answers clearly.

How to care for khaddar

Wash the first time in cold water with mild detergent and dry in the shade. Avoid hard wringing and bleach. Iron on medium heat while slightly damp. If you worry about shrinkage, wash the cloth once before stitching.

Summer vs winter khaddar

Summer khaddar is lighter with an open weave that lets air through. Winter khaddar is denser and warmer with a fuller feel. Choose by season and daily use. Seven meters is enough for a standard suit.

Delivery, payment, returns and contact
